facts.text: I presented a poster on my research on the effects of social media influencers on consumer purchasing decisions at an academic conference on consumer psychology.
I am looking to expand my research on the effects of social media influencers on consumer purchasing decisions.
I am interested in the credibility and trust factors mentioned in a systematic review by Hussain and Ali.
I am particularly interested in how social media influencers establish credibility with their followers.
I am particularly interested in the role of authenticity in establishing credibility.
I want information on how influencers can demonstrate authenticity on social media.
I want information on how consumers perceive authenticity in influencer marketing.
I am interested in learning more about the role of social identity in influencer marketing.
I want information on how social identity theory can explain the effectiveness of social media influencer marketing.
I want information on how influencers can leverage social identity to build a stronger connection with their audience.
I want to explore the role of social identity in influencer marketing in the context of my research on the effects of social media influencers on consumer purchasing decisions.
I want information on how influencers can use social identity to increase brand awareness and drive sales.
